audit_scope: Requirements and claims in the supplied manuscript compared with files in the current folder only. References cited by the manuscript have not been independently verified.
evidence_status: Manuscript claims are not experimental results reproduced from the supplied files.

intended_study.geographic_ambiguity: The manuscript combines Shol in Aktobe with adjoining Atyrau territory without exact study polygons.

supplied_files.metadata_status: Verified against results/input_metadata.json. Eight ECMWF reanalysis-family NetCDF files share two dates, the same 43-by-51 grid and no missing values. Exact ERA5 versus ERA5-Land product lineage and source sampling frequency require the original CDS request.

verified_coverage.quality_note: Tiny negative roundoff in SWVL1 and lake ice is set to zero for analysis only when magnitude is below 1e-12. Original NetCDF inputs and native_grid_values.csv preserve raw values. Snow is zero throughout; lake ice values are effectively zero.

modules.name: Salinity segmentation
required_inputs: Sentinel-2 L2A surface reflectance B2, B3, B4, B8, B8A, B11 and B12, with dates, georeferencing and quality masks
NDVI, NDWI, NDSI, BI and SI1-SI5, with explicit index definitions
ERA5-Land soil-water layers used by the original model
Independent salinity and soil-class observations to validate saline, normal and sandy classes and continuous salinity

modules.reason: No Sentinel-2 bands or independent salinity targets were identified in the folder.

modules.name: Soil profile stratification
required_inputs: Sentinel-2 spectral features
DEM and derived elevation, slope, aspect, curvature, TRI, TPI and distance to water
OpenLandMap static covariates with provenance

modules.proposed_method: Random Forest, Gradient Boosting and XGBoost base learners with linear or logistic stacking; depth-wise class probability entropy

main_methodological_fixes.fix: Define measurable targets, units, forecast horizon, sample counts and spatial support before fitting CSI or describing early-warning skill.
Fit anomaly baselines, preprocessing, cluster stages, stacking and fusion weights only inside training folds; exclude temporal holdout observations from all fitting.

Do not use variance of a series standardized on that same series as an informative feature: it is approximately one by construction. Define rolling or held-out variability against a training baseline if needed.

Keep Mann-Kendall statistic/tau distinct from Sen slope; report physical slope units, sample count and uncertainty. Address seasonality, serial dependence and multiple comparisons before significance claims.
Respect native climate-cell and temporal groups in validation. Resampling coarse climate data to a fine grid does not create independent observations or finer climate information.
Validate soil salinity against independent observations. Accuracy against cluster-derived labels measures cluster reproduction and cannot establish soil salinity accuracy.
Resolve M1 two-cluster versus three-class inconsistency, align cluster labels before voting, handle DBSCAN noise and define continuous salinity targets and spectral formulas.
Train stacking meta-models using out-of-fold base predictions; group depths from the same soil profile and document target provenance.
Treat class entropy as model uncertainty or class mixing until its relationship with observed structural degradation is validated; specify depth aggregation.
Report entropy weights and handle constant or zero indicators. Spatial variation is not evidence of reliability, and weights do not by themselves establish transfer robustness.
Calibrate warning thresholds with actual independent outcomes, report calibration metrics, and use contiguous intervals. The stated quarter ranges leave gaps for continuous scores.
Distinguish erosion-reference agreement from validation of salinity, profile disturbance and future degradation. Prospective outcomes are required for early-warning claims.
Measure held-out surrogate fidelity before interpreting SHAP. Surrogate attributions do not establish causal environmental drivers.
Provide exact regional polygons, datasets, seeds, hyperparameters, fold scores and sample counts; reconcile contradictory M2 summaries and incomplete references.

supported_pilot_scope.description: Use the two supplied daily fields for native-grid spatial reconstruction of topsoil water and an eight-day paired comparison.
candidate_outputs: Verified dataset inventory, provenance and native-grid quality audit
Soil-moisture descriptive summaries and paired changes in physical units
Descriptive associations with temperature, low-vegetation LAI climatology and signed eastward wind
Spatially blocked model comparisons pooling both dates while keeping both observations at each site in the same test block
An untrained eight-day persistence benchmark evaluated on the single date pair
supported_pilot_scope.interpretation_limit: These outputs describe and reconstruct the supplied reanalysis variables. Two dates cannot establish multi-year trends, climate anomalies, robust temporal forecasting skill, salinity, CSI, full SDRI or degradation early-warning validation.
